name: adventureworks-web-e2e
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project adventureworks-web-e2e --web

e2e.// dependsOn: The @nx/playwright/plugin infers a dependency on adventureworks-web:serve (default 'development' config), which would bind port 4200 with the dev-tenant environment before playwright.config.ts's own webServer (serve:playwright on port 4201, test-tenant environment) gets a chance to start. Overriding to [] leaves Playwright in sole control of its test server.
